hub.name: SumIt Internal Tools Hub
hub.description: Browser-based tools for the SumIt Customer Success team. All tools are session-only — no uploaded files are stored after the session ends.

apps.name: K-1 Journal Entry Converter
apps.description: Converts K-1 CSV exports into formatted journal entry rows ready for SumIt import. Accepts a CSV where rows 0-6 contain metadata (account code, entity, effective date, debits/credits label, JE number, description, tags) and rows 8+ contain account data. Runs 6 QA checks: grand total reconciliation, per-JE balance, row completeness, missing values, input structure, and JE count consistency. Outputs a CSV with columns: Journal Entry Number, Entity Name, Effective Date, Account Name, Debits, Credits, Account Code, Description, Tags.
apps.usage_notes: Upload the K-1 CSV, review the input summary, click Run Conversion, verify all 6 QA checks pass, then download the output CSV.

apps.name: Inter-Entity Reconciliation
apps.description: Reconciles Due To / Due From balances across entity pairs from a journal register CSV export. Required CSV columns: Entity, Account, Effective At, Debits, Credits, Accounting Amount, Account Code Group, Account Code. The user selects the Due To account (liability, e.g. '220000 - Office Family Due To') and Due From account (asset, e.g. '120000 - Office Family Due From'). Only rows where Account Code Group = 'Entities' are included. Outputs a summary table per entity pair showing each side's balance and the difference, plus a date-level drilldown and a table of excluded rows.
apps.usage_notes: Upload the journal register CSV, select the Due To and Due From accounts from the dropdowns, click Run Reconciliation. Review summary for mismatches. Export summary or drilldown CSVs as needed.
